summary: Gate commit plays on calibrated CPU cost with raw CPU, wall and steal telemetry and a separate wall hang ceiling

replay.detail: CI harness only; no replay changes.

rules.detail: No product rule or case-set changes.

compatibility.detail: Kit receipts add before/after single/all-CPU calibration, normalized cost, cost status and Linux proc/stat deltas. KIT_PLAY_COST_ANCHOR replaces the wall budget as the cost regression signal; KIT_PLAY_WALL_GUARD_SECONDS replaces KIT_PLAY_MAX_SECONDS as an independent hang ceiling.

manual.detail: Freeze the first stable hosted calibration anchor before evaluating subsequent runs; unstable_vm receipts warn and enforce only the wall ceiling without suppressing story failures.

recovery.detail: No persisted product state changes. Receipts without calibration cannot be judged retroactively.
